title: quercus durandii var. austrina
intro: Quercus durandii var. austrina, commonly known as the Durand oak, is a plant species in the beech family (Fagaceae). It is reported to have various health benefits, including antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help protect against chronic diseases such as heart disease and cancer. The plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its therapeutic actions, including analgesic, antipyretic, and antimicrobial effects. The bioactive constituents of Quercus durandii var. austrina include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
